title: Android Developer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Android Developer
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra, India · On\-site · Full\-time · Mid\-Senior level
 



 QWR Interactive Solutions designs and manufactures head\-worn computing devices. Our XR headsets and smart glasses are Android\-based, and we have shipped over 50,000 devices across 17 countries. We also build HUMBL, a voice\-native AI app.
 



 About the role
 



 We are looking for an Android developer with 2 to 5 years of experience, to work on software that runs on hardware we build ourselves.
 



 Android here is not an app on someone else's phone. It is the operating environment of the product, and it ships in the box. The role spans system\-level work on the device itself and application\-level work on the apps that run on it.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Build and maintain system applications for our Android\-based XR headsets and smart glasses, including the launcher, settings and device services.
 



 Work with hardware and firmware on device bring\-up, sensor integration, display and audio paths, and power behaviour.
 



 Support AOSP customisation, system image builds and over\-the\-air update flows.
 



 Debug across the boundary between application, framework and hardware, using ADB, logcat, systrace and device logs.
 



 Build and maintain native Android applications for our devices, in Kotlin and Java.
 



 Contribute to the Android build of HUMBL, including audio capture, background services, notifications and permissions.
 



 Integrate APIs and SDKs, including speech, AI and analytics services.
 



 Work with design to build interfaces that function on a head\-worn display rather than a phone screen.
 



 Write testable code, maintain unit and instrumentation tests, and work with QA on device test matrices.
 



 Own your releases through to the Play Store or the device OTA channel.
 



 Profile and fix performance, memory, thermal and battery issues, which matter far more on a head\-worn device than on a phone.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
 



 2 to 5 years of Android development with apps that shipped to real users.
 



 Strong Kotlin and working Java. Comfortable in Android Studio and with Gradle.
 



 Solid grasp of the Android framework: lifecycle, services, background execution limits, permissions and Jetpack.
 



 Experience debugging with ADB, logcat and profiling tools.
 



 Comfortable working with physical devices rather than only emulators.
 



 Version control discipline with Git, and the ability to review someone else's code usefully.
 



 Willingness to work close to hardware. This role involves sitting in the lab with devices, not only at a desk.
 



 Nice to Have
 



 AOSP or custom ROM experience.
 



 NDK and C\+\+.
 



 XR, AR or VR development, including OpenXR or Unity.
 



 Audio pipelines and low\-latency capture.
 



 Flutter, or Bluetooth and BLE connectivity work.
 



 CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Fastlane.
 



 Why QWR
 



 Write software for hardware built in the same building. Walk from your desk to the production line.
 



 Work across the full stack of a device, from AOSP up to the app layer. Rare outside the largest OEMs.
 



 Ship into a category still being defined rather than maintaining someone else's legacy app.
 



 Hiring Process
 



 CV screening, a call with the hiring manager, a technical discussion on your previous work, and a short practical exercise. We share feedback within 48 hours of every stage.
 



 How to Apply
 



 Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your CV to hr@questionwhatsreal.com quoting the role title in the subject line. Please include links to apps you have shipped, or a repository we can look at.
 



 QWR Interactive Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applications are considered on merit, without regard to gender, religion, caste, age, disability or background.

 **MES Technical Consultant based in India**

Two profiles fit equally well: a consultant whose primary background is MES (Solumina, MOM, shop\-floor systems) and who has been meaningfully exposed to the Dassault Systèmes ecosystem, or a consultant whose primary background in Dassault Systèmes MES. In short, Solumina MES as a major and Dassault MES as a minor \- or the other way around \-both work for us.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a technical “Swiss knife”: comfortable moving between configuration, data, integrations, custom development, troubleshooting, documentation, testing and customer\-facing support. They will work closely with functional consultants, project teams and customer IT teams to transform user stories into robust, validated solutions across the MES / Digital Thread landscape.

* Act as a Technical Consultant on MES / Solumina projects, supporting configuration, customization, integrations, data migration and deployment activities.
* Work with the project team to translate user stories into technical configuration, interface logic, data requirements and deployable solutions.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, client partners and project managers to estimate requirements, plan activities, prioritize work and execute assigned tasks.
* Work with customer IT teams to map, load, transform and validate data, ensuring the required information is correctly populated in Solumina / MES.

* MES expertise: hands\-on experience working on MES, MOM, shop\-floor systems, Solumina or equivalent manufacturing execution platforms\- whether as a primary specialism or as a strong complementary track to a PLM career.
* Technical stack: strong understanding of Java, JavaScript, Spring, Hibernate, Git, Oracle, SQL Server, PL/SQL, T\-SQL, XML, XSLT, JSON, JEE, JMS, Tomcat / ActiveMQ, React and Redux.

* Mindset: curious, autonomous, hands\-on, growth\-oriented and comfortable evolving quickly in an international PLM / MES ecosystem.

* 5\-8 years of experience in software development, technical consulting, MES delivery or a closely related environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Computing and Information Technologies, or equivalent experience.
* Based in Pune (Maharashtra), India and able to collaborate effectively with international teams across time zones.



  





  





***Razorleaf International — what’s happening and unique here?***



* Looking to further your career in a niche PLM / Digital Manufacturing market?
* Want to work within resilient, complex industries such as Naval, Military, Defense, Aerospace, Pharma and advanced manufacturing?
* Interested in joining an India\-based delivery team connected to international customers and senior PLM / MES experts?



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a rapidly expanding business with strong growth potential, supported by Razorleaf’s partnership with Dassault Systèmes and talented international delivery teams. As a people\-centric organization servicing customers such as Damen, Meyn, Eaton and many others, Razorleaf is expanding its technical delivery capability in India.
 



  





 Within our international division, which connects India, Benelux, Germany, Greece and other growing markets, this role is designed for a hands\-on technical consultant who is at home across both MES and PLM / Dassault Systèmes — able to contribute immediately on day one and to deepen whichever side complements their primary background.

* Navigation: GoRouter, with authentication\-aware redirects.
* Networking: Dio, behind a single configured client with request and error interceptors.
* Local storage: Hive, with generated type adapters.
* Backend services: Firebase Authentication, Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config, Cloud

* gateway integration, deep linking, and Kotlin and Swift for platform\-channel work.

* At least one application published to the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, or a
* substantial project you can demonstrate and explain in detail.

* extensions.
* Practical experience with at least one state management solution (Riverpod preferred; Bloc,
* Provider or GetX acceptable, with an understanding of the trade\-offs).
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, parsing JSON, and handling network and error states.
* Ability to convert design files (Figma or similar) into accurate user interfaces.
* Familiarity with Flutter navigation, app lifecycle, and building layouts that work across
* multiple screen sizes.
* Debugging skills using Flutter DevTools, and the ability to reproduce an issue before fixing it.

* Experience with Riverpod specifically (AsyncNotifier, family and autoDispose providers).
* Experience with local databases such as Hive, SQLite or Drift.
